accelerators.Description: A list of accelerator configurations assigned to this machine type.

guest_accelerator_count.Description: Number of accelerator cards exposed to the guest.

guest_accelerator_type.Description: The accelerator type resource name, not a full URL, e.g. nvidia-tesla-t4.

bundled_local_ssds.Description: The configuration of bundled local SSD for the machine type.

default_interface.Description: The default disk interface if the interface is not specified.

deprecated.Description: The deprecation status associated with this machine type. Only applicable if the machine type is unavailable.

replacement.Description: The URL of the suggested replacement for a deprecated machine type.

state.Description: The deprecation state of this resource. This can be ACTIVE, DEPRECATED, OBSOLETE, or DELETED.

description.Description: A textual description of the machine type.

guest_cpus.Description: The number of virtual CPUs that are available to the instance.

is_shared_cpus.Description: Whether this machine type has a shared CPU.

maximum_persistent_disks_size_gb.Description: The maximum total persistent disks size (GB) allowed.

memory_mb.Description: The amount of physical memory available to the instance, defined in MB.

name.Description: The name of the machine type.

self_link.Description: The server-defined URL for the machine type.

zone.Description: The name of the zone for this request.
